annotation.title_clean: Legal and Ethical Implications of Data Privacy in Artificial Intelligence: A Review of Data Privacy Among Learners in Kenyan Secondary Schools
annotation.title_en: Legal and Ethical Implications of Data Privacy in Artificial Intelligence: A Review of Data Privacy Among Learners in Kenyan Secondary Schools
annotation.venue: Journal of the Kenya National Commission for UNESCO
annotation.summary_en: Systematic literature review of 25 papers (2020–2024) on the legal and ethical implications of AI-related data privacy for learners in Kenyan secondary schools. It finds a need for stronger data privacy frameworks, ethical safeguards and best practices for protecting student data.
key_provisions_or_claims: Kenya's data protection laws are still evolving and may be inadequate for AI in schools
AI surveillance and monitoring of students risks infringing privacy rights
Africa-specific, regionally tailored legal frameworks are needed
Ethical principles and clear consent protocols should be built into AI design and deployment
Little prior research addresses AI data privacy in education in developing countries
